title: East Meadow
shortDescription: Bees stitch the clover beneath a wide, unhurried sky.
longDescription:
Grass bends in silver-green waves around islands of clover. Beyond a low hedge, the sky seems large enough to hold every question the school has ever asked.
A bee skep sits in a patch of sunlight, busy with small purposeful journeys. The gate remains plainly visible to the west; even an excellent daydream need not lose its way home.

fixtures.name: Bee Skep
fixtures.examineDescription: You watch from a respectful distance. Bees return dusted with pollen, disappearing into the woven hive while others depart. A tiny sign says: 'Quiet observers welcome. The bees are working.' The sweetest part of the meadow is mostly somebody else's hard work.
